descriptionMarkdown:
Only Vulcanus & Nauvis Tech (only exception is one Recycler planned for an later Upgrade in Carbonfiber production, but it will work fine without it.)

- Connect the Base with your Yumako and Jellynut Harvesters (there are Entrys in all 4 Edges). 4 Yumako Harvester and 2 Jellynut Harvester at a good location are enough.

- Connect a Water Source to the South (or any other part of the water pipe, South is the easiest way).

- Add Fuel to Power the Base, once all is running the Base will be selfsufficient.

- Add 1000 Spoilage to start Nutrient Production.

- Add a Pentapod Egg in both Science Parts to Start Science production.

- Connect Stone in the North-West of the Base.

- Add Logistic Bots (500 should be more than enough)

- Add Rocket Silo(s) and a Landing Hub.

- Add Storage Chests


The Base will notify you if something important is missing (like: no Fruit-Input, Water low, Power low, missing Pentapod Egg)

[Part of my Gleba Book](-P5TcUTUwvCm_VzkexLH)
